name: bollinger_ema_sar_v3_5m
purpose: Change only the chart timeframe from 1 minute to 5 minutes while preserving the V2 trading logic and data-governance rules.
bar_construction: Causal 5-minute OHLCV aggregation from Databento 1-minute bars using open=first, high=max, low=min, close=last, volume=sum.
unchanged_logic: 2-left/2-right confirmed structural swing on the active 5m bars
EMA20 non-lateral slope filter: 5-bar directional EMA20 move >= 5% of current Bollinger bandwidth
rocket rejection or body engulfing signal
higher signal low for LONG / lower signal high for SHORT
stop at low/high of candle immediately before signal
target = 40% of Bollinger bandwidth at signal close
maximum holding = 3 bars (15 minutes on 5m chart)
NY anchor contextual only, never a hard 09:00-12:00 gate
comparison: Compare against V1 1m and V2 1m without changing any other rule. Primary goals: increase usable sample, reduce microstructure noise, and measure expectancy/PF/DD rather than win rate alone.
